local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
local Window = Library.CreateLib("OpScripts - Generic Roleplay Game", "DarkTheme")
local Tab = Window:NewTab("Main")
local Section = Tab:NewSection("Main")

Section:NewButton("Remove Ac", "Removes a ac", function()
    local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local ch = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local ac1 = ch:WaitForChild("Slow", 1)
    if ac1 then
        ac1:Destroy()
    end
end)

local at = false
Section:NewToggle("Annoy all near", "Annoys all near u", function(state)
    at = state
    if state then
        task.spawn(function()
            local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
            while at do
                local ch = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
                local Head = ch:WaitForChild("Head")
                local ServerSoundEvent = ch:WaitForChild("ServerSoundEvent")

                for _, sound in pairs(Head:GetChildren()) do
                    if sound:IsA("Sound") then
                        ServerSoundEvent:FireServer(sound, "Play")
                    end
                end

                task.wait(0.01)

				if not ch.Parent then
                    lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

else

end
